description: Java class implementing an AMQP endpoint for managing device connection information within the Eclipse Hono project. It handles incoming messages, creates event bus requests, and generates AMQP replies.

classes.name: DeviceConnectionAmqpEndpoint
classes.description: A class extending RequestResponseEndpoint to handle device connection messages over AMQP, including message creation, verification, and reply generation.

methods.name: DeviceConnectionAmqpEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor initializing the endpoint with a Vertx instance.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the endpoint, used for identification.

methods.name: getEventBusServiceAddress
methods.description: Provides the address on the event bus for device connection messages.

methods.name: createEventBusRequestMessage
methods.description: Creates an EventBusMessage from an incoming AMQP message, handling JSON decoding errors.

methods.name: passesFormalVerification
methods.description: Verifies if the message passes device connection-specific validation.

methods.name: getAmqpReply
methods.description: Generates an AMQP reply message based on the event bus message.
